novel_mechanics_found: L5 separates tuple control across two distinct tiles: the upper black-dot tile cycles shape, while the small blue/black tile in the lower-left chamber rotates the selected shape. The L5 target requires the six-cell X.X/XX./.XX shape in color 8; the black tile exposes its 180-degree orientation and the lower tile advances orientation on alternating re-entries. The apparently inert upper B-ring is directional/delayed: vertical entry did not reset the counter, but traversing/departing it horizontally after the pinwheel launcher reset the counter to 42. A launcher beside the pinwheel sends the player from the middle corridor directly to the upper ring in one action. These findings expose a likely three-reset choreography (left ring, upper directional ring, bottom ring), but no new level was won.
narrative: The exact 244-action registry prefix was replayed first from a fresh reset and live-confirmed frame.levels_completed=4. I then explored L5 through rendered frames for 124 actions, mapped the shape/color/orientation controls, verified the pinwheel's C->9->E->8 color route, found the direct pinwheel-to-upper-ring launcher, and determined why the upper ring initially looked inert. Three counter deaths were used during exploration. After GAME_OVER, I attempted to reuse env.reset() and replayed the exact 244-action prefix, but that reused environment ended at level 0 rather than restoring a replayable fresh state; those calls still count, bringing the session to 612. With only 88 calls left—insufficient for another genuinely fresh 244-action prefix—I stopped honestly at the banked level 4. No reproduction gate for a new level was run.
gotchas: L5 counter drains by 2 per action; blocked moves drain it too.
The upper B-ring can appear inert when entered vertically, but horizontal traversal/departure after the pinwheel launcher resets the counter to 42.
The black-dot tile cycles shape; the lower blue/black tile controls orientation and visibly advances only on alternating re-entries.
The required L5 target tuple is color 8 with shape X.X/XX./.XX; the matching underlying shape appears at the black pad as its 180-degree orientation.
Moving right from the corridor immediately east of the pinwheel triggers a free vertical launcher slide to the upper ring.

Do not rely on env.reset() after exhausting all lives in a reused env: in this session the exact verified prefix then replayed to level 0. Open a genuinely fresh env/scorecard before replay, and reserve the full 244 calls.

The likely solve order is: set shape, collect left reset, set color at pinwheel, use launcher and horizontal upper-ring reset, collect bottom reset, set orientation, then approach the target through the right corridor.
